title: SB 259 (2021 Regular Session): AN ACT relating to elections.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 28 (KRS 117.225(1))
(quote) Any person desiring to vote on election day shall give his or her name and address to the clerk of the election and shall provide proof of identification as defined in Section 41 of this Act[KRS 117.375].
(section) Sec. 30 (KRS 117.227)
(quote) Except as otherwise provided, election officers shall confirm the identity of each voter by proof of identification as defined in Section 41 of this Act[KRS 117.375]. The election officer confirming the identity shall sign the precinct voter roster and list the method of proof of identification.
(section) Sec. 41 (KRS 117.375 renumbered KRS 117.001(13))
(quote) "Proof of identification" means a document that was issued by: (a) The United States or the Commonwealth of Kentucky, and the document contains: 1. The name of the individual to whom the document was issued; and 2. A photograph of the individual to whom the document was issued; (b) The United States Department of Defense, a branch of the uniformed services, the Merchant Marine, or the Kentucky National Guard ...; (c) A public or private college, university, or postgraduate technical or professional school located within the United States ...; or (d) Any city government, county government, urban-county government, charter county government, consolidated local government, or unified local government, which is located within this state ... [each with name and photograph]
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Sec. 31 (KRS 117.228(1))
(quote) Except as provided in subsection (4) of this section, on the day of a primary, an election, or during in-person absentee voting, if a voter is unable to provide proof of identification as required under KRS 117.225, and as defined under Section 41 of this Act[KRS 117.375], a voter may cast a ballot if the individual: (a) Is eligible to vote under KRS 116.025; (b) Is entitled to vote in that precinct; and (c) In the presence of the election officer, executes a voter's affirmation ...
(section) Sec. 31 (KRS 117.228(2))
(quote) In addition to the requirements of subsection (1) of this section, to cast a ballot, the voter who is unable to provide proof of identification shall provide to an election officer: (a) The voter's Social Security Card; ... (c) Any identification card with the voter's photograph and the name of the voter stated; ... (e) A credit or debit card with the name of the voter stated.
(section) Sec. 32 (KRS 117.229)
(quote) the voter may cast a provisional ballot for the federal elective office of President, Vice President, United States Senator, and United States House of Representative if the individual conforms to the provisional voting requirements in accordance with the Help America Vote Act of 2002.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) Sec. 11 (KRS 117.085(1))
(quote) all requests for a mail-in absentee ballot shall be requested through a secure online portal established by the State Board of Elections. Acquiring a mail-in absentee ballot by means of the online portal shall require the voter to input personally identifiable information for verification. ... The online portal shall have the capacity to ensure the identity of the voter through proof of identification as required under Section 31 of this Act and as defined in Section 41 of this Act.
(section) Sec. 11 (KRS 117.085(2))
(quote) The mail-in absentee ballot application form shall be verified and signed by the voter, and the voter shall provide a copy of his or her proof of identification, as defined in Section 41 of this Act[KRS 117.375], or the executed voter affirmation as described in KRS 117.228(1)(c).
(section) Sec. 11 (KRS 117.085(6))
(quote) the county clerk shall retain the voter's mail-in ballot application[ form], which shall include the photographed copy of the voter's proof of identification or the voter affirmation as prescribed by KRS 117.228(1)(c), and the postal form ... for twelve (12) months after the day of a primary or an election[twenty-two (22) months after the primary or election].
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 31 (KRS 117.228(1)(c)1.)
(quote) The voter is a citizen of the United States;
(section) Sec. 24 (KRS 117.187, election-officer training list)
(quote) (s) Proof of identification; and (t) Information concerning the secure online portal to request a mail-in absentee ballot.
(other) Secs. 1-4, 5-10 (KRS 83A.045, 116.045, 116.046, 116.112, new ch. 117 section, 117.015-117.066): paper ballots, registration periods and inactive voters, precinct officer eligibility and hours, consolidation of precincts.
(other) Sec. 11 (KRS 117.085): online portal required for nearly all mail-in requests (covered voters excepted); portal closes 11:59 p.m. local time ten days before the election; in-person early voting; ballot retention cut from 22 to 12 months.
(other) Secs. 12-15 (KRS 117.086, 117.0863, 117.087, 117.088): drop boxes for mail-in ballots and early counting of mail-in ballots.
(other) Secs. 16-27, 29, 33-40 (KRS 117.105-117.215, 117.235, 117.245-117.355): election-day procedure, voting equipment, ballot and equipment terms, conforming changes; 117.245 oath excludes challenges for failure to show proof of identification.
(other) Sec. 41: KRS 117.375 repealed, reenacted and renumbered KRS 117.001 - definitions moved and expanded (audit log, risk-limiting audit, voting equipment, etc.); the 'proof of identification' definition moves to (13).
(other) Secs. 42-46 (KRS 117.377-117.385, 117.995): voting-equipment and penalty changes.
(other) Secs. 47-57 (KRS 118.015-118.415): candidate filing, primaries, ballot questions and advocacy.
(other) Secs. 58-63 (KRS 118A): recount and contest procedures.
(other) Secs. 64-71 (KRS 119, 120, 242.120, 424.290): election-related conforming and notice changes.
(other) Sec. 72 (KRS 132.017): tax-levy related ballot matter.
(other) Sec. 73: repeals KRS 117.381 and 117.387 (electronic voting systems).
(other) version: orig_bill (the only version): introduced text, 145 pages. ID text in slots a-c is mostly existing law with 'KRS 117.375' replaced by 'Section 41 of this Act'; genuinely changed is the portal requirement in Sec. 11. No other versions saved.
(other) note: Introduced only; to Committee on Committees; no further action. Bracketed words are deleted. The in-person ID rule (117.225, 117.227), the no-ID affirmation and secondary-ID list (117.228) and the federal provisional ballot (117.229) are reprinted with only the cross-reference changed ('Section 41 of this Act[KRS 117.375]'). Section 41 moves the 'proof of identification' definition into KRS 117.001(13); the old definition (struck, in brackets, as (12)) and the new one list the same four issuers, each requiring name and photograph; the only wording differences are small ('and if the document contains' becomes 'and the document contains'). I did not compare the 117.228 list of impediments word for word; those lines carry no brackets or new-section marker, so I read them as reprinted law. Slot c is the main change: nearly all mail-in requests must go through the portal, which must check identity by proof of identification 'as required under Section 31'. The 145-page text was located by text search, not read line by line; minor ID mentions (KRS 117.245 oath exclusion, KRS 117.045 county-board rulings on proof of identification) are noted only under other subjects.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
